query.en: Where is the Canada Border Services Agency listed?
query.fr: Où figure l’Agence des services frontaliers du Canada?

required: Schedule IV
Two distinct legislative annotations for one bilingual name
reject: Two agencies inferred solely from duplicate schedule entries

query.en: Which manual applies to self-employed applications received May 2 and May 3, 2017?
query.fr: Quelles instructions s’appliquent aux demandes de travailleurs autonomes reçues les 2 et 3 mai 2017?

required: Receipt on 2017-05-02 uses OP 8
Receipt on 2017-05-03 uses the program delivery instructions
Cite the selected language’s receipt-date rule
reject: Treating today’s online wording as a verified historical snapshot

query.en: Find CFIA’s published algorithmic impact assessment for the ERA-Food model.
query.fr: Retrouver l’évaluation de l’incidence algorithmique de l’ACIA pour le modèle d’évaluation du risque des établissements alimentaires.

required: Issuing institution is CFIA
Catalogue record f77faef4-27d8-4929-929e-bfb1371affde
Separate catalogue metadata from the cited assessment edition
reject: Inferring approval or a model performance metric from its listing

query.en: What did ECCC disclose about freshwater briefing MIN - 262510?
query.fr: Qu’a divulgué ECCC sur la note d’information sur l’eau douce MIN - 262510?

required: Institution and reference MIN - 262510
Received 2020-02-04
Strategic Policy Branch; minister; for information
Return the title in the requested language where evidenced
reject: Inventing memo text or treating the register entry as a full-text source

query.en: What did ECCC publish about engagement on creating a Canada Water Agency?
query.fr: Qu’a publié ECCC au sujet de la consultation sur la création d’une Agence canadienne de l’eau?

required: Locate ECCC’s engagement summary and its reference to the December 2020 discussion paper
Credit the consultation publisher and distinguish submissions from departmental findings
reject: Attributing every participant’s view to the department

query.en: Which reviews did CFIA propose in its 2024–2026 regulatory stock review plan?
query.fr: Quels examens l’ACIA a-t-elle proposés dans son plan d’examen de l’inventaire des règlements de 2024 à 2026?

required: Identify CFIA, the plan period, and the entry’s stated review status
Cite the plan entry
reject: Inferring enactment or regulatory commencement from a planned review

query.en: What value did ECCC publish for agreement GCXE20P030?
query.fr: Quelle valeur ECCC a-t-il publiée pour l’accord GCXE20P030?

required: Agreement GCXE20P030
Agreement value 287280.00 CAD
Cite the award and distinguish agreement value from disbursements
reject: Treating the agreement value as verified actual expenditure
Linking this agreement to the Lake Winnipeg research vessel on topic alone

query.en: Who owned the Lake Winnipeg research platform funding-model action, and when was it due?
query.fr: À qui incombait le modèle de financement de la plateforme de recherche du lac Winnipeg et quelle était l’échéance?

required: Recommendation 1; assigned office ARDG West and North Region or DGRA, région de l’Ouest et du Nord
Target 2027-03-31; cite section 3.2

required: June 2024, table 1
Centre of Expertise reported completed
Audit assessed in progress because the documents had been withdrawn
Return both attributed cells with their row headers

query.en: Find the French edition of the freshwater quality science evaluation.
query.fr: Retrouver l’édition française de l’évaluation de la science de la qualité de l’eau douce.

required: French report resolves via publisher language link
Preserve edition URL and discovery path
reject: Reporting missing translation solely because one index omits it
